claim: Costco's diluted EPS down 17% from the prior year in fiscal 2024
summary: From prior knowledge, Costco's FY2024 diluted EPS increased about 17% year-over-year, not decreased 17%. The direction is opposite, so the claim is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Costco's diluted EPS decreased by 17% in fiscal 2024 compared to fiscal 2023.
sub_claims.stated_text: diluted EPS down 17% from the prior year in fiscal 2024
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge without tools: Costco FY2024 diluted EPS increased about 17% year-over-year (FY2023 ~$14.16 to FY2024 ~$16.56), not decreased.
